notes.title: Patch 2.0
notes.content:
[h2][b]The update data for “TEKKEN 8” will be distributed with the following details:[/b][/h2]

[h3]Ver.2.00.01[/h3]

[h2][u]Application Date and Time[/u][/h2]

[h3][CEST] From around 0:00 AM on Tuesday, April 1st, applied sequentially[/h3]
[h3][PDT] From around 3:00 PM on Monday, March 31st, applied sequentially[/h3]

[h2][u]Maintenance Date and Time[/u][/h2]

[h3][CEST] Monday, March 31st, 11:30 PM – Tuesday, April 1st, 6:00 AM[/h3]
[h3][PDT] Monday, March 31st, 2:30 PM – 9:00 PM[/h3]

[h3]Note:[/h3]
[h3]Please note that the date and time may change without prior notice.[/h3]
[h3]All online content will be unavailable during maintenance.[/h3]

[h2][u]Impact of the Update[/u][/h2]

[h3]The application of the update data will affect the following modes and features:[/h3]

[h3]“DOWNLOADED REPLAYS” / “MY REPLAY & TIPS”[/h3]
[h3]Replay data from before the update will no longer be playable.[/h3]
[h3]“ONLINE REPLAY”[/h3]
[h3]All replay data from before the update will be deleted.[/h3]
[h3]“SUPER GHOST BATTLE” / “GHOST MATCH” / “Ghost vs. Ghost”[/h3]
[h3]The behavior and performance of characters after the update will be reflected in ghost data. There will be no loss of data.[/h3]

[h2][u]The details of the update are as follows:[/u][/h2]

[h2][u]Downloadable Content (Paid DLC)[/u][/h2]

[h3]Playable Character “Anna Williams”[/h3]
[h3]The character “Anna” will be available on each platform store starting from the following dates:[/h3]

[h3][u]1) Early Access[/u][/h3]

[h3][CEST] Tuesday, April 1st at around 1:00 AM[/h3]
[h3][PDT] Monday, March 31st at around 4:00 PM[/h3]

[h3]Note:[/h3]
[h3]Early access (72 hours) is available by purchasing one of the following bundles released on the above date:[/h3]

[h3]For those who own the base game of “TEKKEN 8”:[/h3]
[h3]“TEKKEN 8 Season 2 Character & Stage Pass”[/h3]
[h3]“TEKKEN 8 Season 2 Character Pass”[/h3]

[h3]For those who do not own the base game of “TEKKEN 8”:[/h3]
[h3]“TEKKEN 8 Season 2 Ultimate Edition”[/h3]
[h3]“TEKKEN 8 Season 2 Deluxe Edition”[/h3]

[h3][u]2) General Access[/u][/h3]

[h3][CEST] Friday, April 4th at around 1:00 AM[/h3]
[h3][PDT] Thursday, April 3rd at around 4:00 PM[/h3]

[h3]Note:[/h3]
[h3]General access becomes available by purchasing the “Anna” downloadable content released on the above date.[/h3]

[h2][u]TEKKEN SHOP[/u][/h2]

[h3]Added “TEKKEN FIGHT PASS -ROUND 5-”[/h3]
[h3]Complete missions during the period to level up and earn various items[/h3]
[h3]“PREMIUM” grants more items than “FREE”[/h3]
[h3]“FREE” allows up to 100 TEKKEN COINS to be earned[/h3]
[h3]In addition to the 100 coins from “FREE,” “PREMIUM” grants up to 600 more, for a total of 700 TEKKEN COINS[/h3]

[h3]Added Avatar Skin “Anna”[/h3]
[h3]An avatar skin usable in “TEKKEN FIGHT LOUNGE”[/h3]
[h3]To celebrate Anna’s release, it is available at a limited-time sale price of 75% OFF (100 TEKKEN COINS)[/h3]

[h3]“TEKKEN SPECIAL DEAL” Event Held[/h3]
[h3]Selected items are available at special prices during the event[/h3]

[h2][u]TEKKEN FIGHT LOUNGE[/u][/h2]

[h3]Five Special Ghosts Appearing with Obtainable Character Panels[/h3]
[h3]Talk to and defeat them to obtain one character panel each[/h3]
[h3]Character panels are fan art works submitted through the “TEKKEN FANDOM Campaign”[/h3]
[h3]Special Ghosts will appear in the lobby until the next update scheduled for May[/h3]
[h3]They will be replaced with new Special Ghosts in the next update[/h3]

[h2][u]TEKKEN BALL[/u][/h2]

[h3]Adjusted ball return behavior for certain moves in “TEKKEN BALL” mode[/h3]

[h2][u]RANKED MATCH[/u][/h2]

[h3][b]① Matching has been changed so that players can battle others with a closer skill level[/b][/h3]

[h3]Matchmaking System Changes in Ranked Match[/h3]
[h3]Matchmaking based on “Tekken Prowess” has been removed[/h3]
[h3]Matchmaking now considers the rank of the character currently in use and the player’s highest rank among all used characters[/h3]

[h3]Sub-Character Rank Inheritance System Adjustments[/h3]
[h3]Changed the timing and target rank for sub-character rank inheritance[/h3]
[h3]When the highest reached rank among all characters is updated, rank inheritance will be applied[/h3]

[h3]Search Criteria Changes[/h3]
[h3]Added “Same Rank Only” to Rank Restrictions[/h3]
[h3]Changed “±1 Preferred”, “±2 Preferred”, and “±3 Preferred” to “±1 or lower”, “±2 or lower”, and “±3 or lower”[/h3]
[h3][i]Note: These changes make it less likely to match with opponents whose rank is outside the selected range[/i][/h3]

[h2][u]New Ranks Added Beyond “Destruction God”[/u][/h2]

[h3]Eight new ranks added after “Destruction God”:[/h3]

[h3]God of Destruction I / II / III / IV / V / VI / VII / ∞ (Ouroboros)
[/h3]
[h3][u]Note: The difficulty of ranking up increases significantly in the ranks beyond “Destruction God”[/u][/h3]

[h2][u]Rank Reset Implemented[/u][/h2]

[h3]At the start of Season 2, ranks are determined based on the highest rank achieved in Season 1[/h3]

[h3]Special Titles will be awarded based on the highest rank achieved in Season 1 as part of the rank reset process[/h3]

[h3][b]② The following changes have been made to create a more competitive and satisfying point system[/b][/h3]

[h3]Point Gain/Loss System Adjustments[/h3]

[h3]The higher your opponent’s rank, the more points you earn for a win
The lower your opponent’s rank, the more points you lose for a defeat
[/h3]
(Examples)

[h3][u]1) Lower-Ranked Match[/u][/h3]

[h3]You: “Fujin” (Rank 21) vs Opponent: “Battle Ruler” (Rank 20)
> Win: +720pt / Loss: -1280pt[/h3]

[h3][u]2) Same-Rank Match[/u][/h3]

[h3]You: “Fujin” (Rank 21) vs Opponent: “Fujin” (Rank 21)
> Win: +1000pt / Loss: -1000pt[/h3]

[h3][u]3) Higher-Ranked Match[/u][/h3]

[h3]You: “Fujin” (Rank 21) vs Opponent: “Raijin” (Rank 22)
> Win: +1280pt / Loss: -720pt

Promotion bonus points are now only awarded once upon reaching a new highest rank
The system that caused a significant point drop after 3 consecutive losses has been removed
The win streak bonus system has been adjusted:
- Bonus points for win streaks are now only available up to “Tenryu” (Rank 17)
- For ranks “Tenryu” and below, bonus points start applying after 3 consecutive wins
- For ranks “Tenryu” and below, the more wins in a row, the greater the additional points earned[/h3]

[h2][u]QUICK MATCH[/u][/h2]

[h3]Added “Rank Restriction” Option to Search Criteria[/h3]

[h3]Now possible to choose from:
”Same Rank Only” / “±1 or lower” / “±2 or lower” / “±3 or lower” / “No Restriction”[/h3]

[h2][u]“RANKED MATCH”, “QUICK MATCH”, “VERSUS”, “PLAYER MATCH”[/u][/h2]

[h3]Added “In-Battle Status”[/h3]

[h3]Now displays combo count and combo damage in actual battles, just like in “Practice” mode
To turn the display OFF, go to OPTIONS > “Screen Settings” > “In-Battle Status Settings” > toggle ON/OFF
In “PRACTICE” and “MY REPLAY & TIPS”, you can toggle it from the “Display Settings” in the pause menu[/h3]

[h2][u]PRACTICE[/u][/h2]

[h3]Added a Special Practice-Only Stage[/h3]

[h3]A practice-only stage with a wall distance of approximately 500m is now available
Select “Practice Stage” under “Restart Settings” and press [Touchpad/View button/V] + [×/A/J] (normal restart method) to switch to the practice stage
You can also switch to the practice stage by pressing [Touchpad/View button/V] + [↑]
To return to the original stage after switching with [Touchpad/View button/V] + [↑], press [Touchpad/View button/V] + [×/A/J][/h3]

[h3]New Items Added to the Reversal Move List[/h3]

[h3]The following CPU actions can now be set:
Heat Burst / Heat Burst (Cancel) / Standing Block / Crouching Block /
Low Parry / Dash / Back Dash / Sidestep (Into Background) /
Side Walk (Into Background) / Sidestep (Into Foreground) / Side Walk (Into Foreground)[/h3]

[h2][u]OPTIONS[/u][/h2]

[h3]Added “V-Sync” Setting[/h3]

[h3]“V-Sync” settings are now available on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S
Can be toggled ON/OFF via Options > Graphics Settings > V-Sync[/h3]

[h2][u]LEADERBOARDS[/u][/h2]

[h3]Now Reflects Season 2 Stats[/h3]

[h3]Season 1 leaderboards have been reset
Online ranking data from Season 2 is now viewable[/h3]

[h2][u]“PLAY DATA”[/u][/h2]

[h3]Now Reflects Season 2 Stats[/h3]

[h3]Season 1 stats have been reset in the following categories:
BATTLE (ONLINE), OTHER (ONLINE section only), PLAYSTATS, CHARACTER DATA (ONLINE)
Newly accumulated stats from Season 2 are now displayed[/h3]

[h2][u]Playable Characters[/u][/h2]

[h3]Character Move Behavior Fixes and Balance Adjustments[/h3]

[h3]Please check the article at the following URLs for details on the fixes and adjustments: [url=https://www.tekken-official.jp/tekken_news/?p=942]Link[/url][/h3]

[h2][u]TEKKEN Talk Live Season 2 Special[/u][/h2]

[h3]Covers the main direction of ranked match and battle balance adjustments in “Season 2”[/h3]

[h3]YouTube : [url=https://www.youtube.com/live/xmik3NHJGjI]Link[/url][/h3]

[h2][u]TEKKEN Talk Live Season 2 & Anna Special[/u][/h2]

[h3]Showcases “Season 2” battle balance adjustments and live gameplay of the new character “Anna”[/h3]

[h3] YouTube : [url=https://www.youtube.com/live/Z5G9cCvMfvY]Link[/url][/h3]

[b]Thank you for your continued support of “TEKKEN 8”.[/b]

[h3]This latest saga begins where the previous title left off, with a [b]world mired deep in the devastating war [/b]between Kazuya Mishima and Jin Kazama. After suffering what seems to be a defeat from Kazuya, [b]Jin faces his own fate[/b]. His mother, Jun Kazama, appears after her absence from the TEKKEN franchise to try and turn the tide in this blood feud.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136267/799aa530977566982fe0f529437f7b1bf3032c73.jpg[/img]
